description:
Ask another party to an agreed deal to pay you. Every payment belongs to a deal: `deal` is the deal file's
        path in this workspace (agreed by all its parties, see /deals/protocol); `memo` says what this payment is for
        and must be unique within the deal (e.g. "draft delivered"). amount_usdc e.g. "5"; pay_to is your receiving
        address (0x..., the same on every supported network). hashn logs it as payments/<request_id>.md and in the
        deal's log, and updates both when it's paid. hashn never holds the money.
name: request_payment
